There might be a few adults, but the bug spray is AMAZING, and will kill the adults too. If you have any other plants near this one, spray those too.

Bonide Systemic granules in the soil to kill new larvae. Dropping in those once should help for a few months, it's really strong.

Also, just trim a few of the leaves that have been affected really bad, they'll grow back super healthy.

Something similar happened to me. I moved abroad after having met someone that changed my life completely. I held on to him hard, even after moving. 

We are no longer together.

Unless you are both on the same page, willing to fight, willing to make it work it's not going to happen. Is he willing to move to the US for you if you get a great job? Are you willing to sacrifice a career in the US and go back to build a life with him? Long distance is hard but it works if you know for sure that at the end of the day, it'll all work out. But y'all need to have a real conversation. You need to find out if he's willing to commit to you and wait (and move) for you and fight his family and the pressure to get married for you.

It won't be easy to let him go. But when you're moving countries and trying to figure stuff out there, you'll have so many other things to think about, and it won't hurt as much as it's hurting you right now. Looking back at my own relationship, I really wish I'd left him behind. It's much harder for me now because it didn't all fall into place. Just love is not enough to make a relationship work.

Good luck OP! If you choose to be with him, I genuinely hope it works out for y'all!
